name: speeding-merge
description: Two over-limit stretches separated by a 4 s dip merge into one episode.
mirrors: speeding.test.ts › merges episodes separated by a short dip

headline.text: 12 over for 1 min 24 s on a residential street. The limit is a ceiling, not a suggestion with a tip jar.

lines.text: Hard brake on that road, 4.0 m/s². Did the road end early or did you just notice it?
